context: M2 o4c. The 11th-floor corridor after Prentiss's two 'movers' have been thrown down the stairs.

lines.speaker: char.walter_hollis
lines.text: Shipmate! Two of 'em! Like the old days in Marseille!

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: They said they were moving your furniture, Mr. Hollis.

lines.speaker: char.walter_hollis
lines.text: My furniture is a chair and a radio. I'm keeping both.
